en.title: Tesla Optimus Gen 3: New Dexterity Milestones and a Roadmap to Mass Production
en.summary: Tesla reveals Optimus Gen 3 with 22-DoF hands, improved battery life, and a concrete timeline for consumer availability starting at $20,000.
